scope: CENSUS - every GEN/clip storyboard row whose Speaker is LUKE or GF (solo), plus all LUKE/GF mixed rows measured separately. Nothing sampled.

method.source_files: v2/clips/Sxx.mp4 - verified by waveform correlation (r=1.0) to be the exact files in rough_cut_v6 segments; the _roll_* alternates are NOT in the cut.
method.windows: faster-whisper 'small' word timestamps; F0 measured only inside words
method.estimator: librosa.pyin 60-500 Hz on the vocals stem (median of voiced frames)
method.note_on_narrow_ranges: octave_arbiter.py explicitly warns a narrow fmin/fmax cannot settle an octave question because it FORCES the answer. So pyin stays wide (60-500) and the harmonic comb + autocorrelation reject octave errors instead.

strict_calm_and_high_confidence.description: STRICTEST cut: non-shouted lines only, AND pyin/torchaudio agree within 40 Hz. This is the claim that survives every objection (arousal, octave error, measurement noise).

in_band_clips.note: the non-outlier clips sit in a band roughly consistent with a single human (a human moves ~30-40 Hz total across takes) - so the outlier framing is fair, not an artifact of a smeared distribution
